what: JLCPCB pages read anonymously for the order-package dry run. "parts" holds the latest dated rendered part-page receipts (2026-11-22, sanitized copies in the private repository); earlier receipts stay unchanged under "parts_history". "pages" keeps the 2026-11-12 receipts the package rules cite; "factory_review" is the 2026-11-22 capability review. Every receipt keeps its retrieval time and the SHA-256 of the bytes served. None is a quote, reservation, lead time or assembly acceptance.

JLCPCB supports Through-Hole Technology (THT) component assembly and mixed-technology (SMD + THT) PCB assembly within a single PCBA order.
This service is available under both the Economic and Standard PCBA.
Assembled PCBs are typically shipped with manufacturing rails (tooling edges) attached by default.
Delivery Format Single PCB, Panel with mouse bites Single PCB, Panel with mouse bites, Panel with V-cut
Thickness Tolerance (Thickness≥1.0mm) ± 10% e.g. For the 1.6mm board thickness, the finished board thickness ranges from 1.44mm(T-1.6×10%) to 1.76mm(T+1.6×10%)
Thickness Tolerance (Thickness ± 0.1mm e.g. For the 0.8mm board thickness, the finished board thickness ranges from 0.7mm(T-0.1) to 0.9mm(T+0.1).
Surface Finish HASL (leaded / lead-free), ENlG, OSP
Panelization is recommended for small-sized boards.
For SMT assembly at JLCPCB, use 5 mm tooling edges, 2 mm tooling holes, and 1 mm fiducials centered at 3.85 mm from the
⑤ Minimum tooling edge width: 3 mm. For SMT assembly at JLCPCB, use 5 mm tooling edges, 2 mm tooling holes, and 1 mm fiducials centered at 3.85 mm from the panel edges.
For breakaway with mouse-bites, the minimum width is 5mm.
The spacing between boards should be ≥ 2 mm, as narrow spacing results in difficulties for routing and V-cut.
JLCPCB expects these columns: Designator, Mid X, Mid Y, Rotation and Layer. Coordinates should be in millimetres.
Before uploading you must rename/rearrange the columns to Comment, Designator, Footprint, JLCPCB Part #
KiCad writes headers Ref, PosX, PosY, Rot, Side, which you then rename to Designator, Mid X, Mid Y, Rotation, Layer for JLCPCB.
Mid X/Mid Y - The X/Y coordinate of the component centroid. Required units: Metric(mm).
Layer - Top / Bottom, the board side where the component should be placed.
Rotation - The rotation of the component given in degrees. Positive values are counter clockwise.

When you have only one design in your PCB Gerber file and you need JLCPCB to help you duplicate multiple copies onto one panel, you can select the ' Panel By JLCPCB ' option. Simply check ' Yes ' in the ' Panel By JLCPCB ' section and fill in the number of rows (Y) and columns (X) of PCBs you want to place on one panel.
If you order 10pcs PCBs, you will receive a total of 10 big panels, with each panel containing 6 PCBs, resulting in a total of 60 individual PCBs.
By default, we will add a 5mm board edge
Note: If either side of the single PCB is within 15mm, there will be extra cost for v-cut process since it is more difficult to apply v-cut on small PCBs.
Please ensure that the board outline is simple. For complex board outlines, you will need to panelize them yourself.
The panel size needs to be 70*70mm at least to do v-cut process.
V-cut is not supported in Economic Assembly. If V-cut and assembly is required, please select Standard Assembly.

Please kindly note that if you select "Panel by JLCPCB" with the Edge Rails, fiducial marks and tooling holes will be added to the Edge Rails by default. Fiducial marks will not be added to each small piece in the panel.
Mouse-bites and V-cut are available, for Economic assembly, please panelize your boards with mouse-bites. for Standard assembly, you can panelize with mouse-bites or V-cut.
12. Do I need to add fiducial marks myself? No, you don't have to. We'll add fiducial marks for SMT assembly.
If the board thickness is 0.4mm or 0.6mm, the carrier shall be used for printing and component placement.
However, for PCB with a thickness of 0.8mm or more, a carrier is also required because there is a risk of board breakage resulting from unreasonable paneling.
If Do Not Place is selected, those designators will be left unpopulated by default, meaning no components will be assembled.

part_field_meanings.note: Fields read from each part page payload (componentInfo). library from componentLibraryType (base = Basic, expand = Extended); in_stock from overseasStockCount, which the 2026-11-06 A5 audit mapped to the UI "In Stock"; preorder_available from canPresaleNumber; preorder_minimum from preMinPurchaseNum. loss_number and least_patch_number are recorded without an established meaning. pcba_type and assembly_type are the "PCBA Type" and "Assembly Type" labels shown on the same rendered part pages (raw_sha256 covers that HTML).

topics.reading: ENIG is offered. At 0.8 mm Economic PCBA lists HASL only, so ENIG at 0.8 mm needs Standard PCBA, which both 0.8 mm boards already require. Any trace left without mask must meet 0.25/0.25 mm and ENIG.
topics.factory_question: Whether JLC CAM/DFM accepts the large mask openings that expose ENIG copper around pads, and confirmation that no trace is left uncovered (else the 0.25/0.25 mm uncovered-trace rule applies). Not checked against the Gerbers by this review.

topics.design: pad_margin 0.15, trace_margin 0.10, via_web 0.10 mm (JLC green 1 oz row), ink 10 um convention

stated.quote: Soldermask bridge 0.10mm 1oz: Min. pad spacing: 0.10 mm (green, red, yellow, blue, purple) Min. pad spacing: 0.13 mm (black, white) 2oz: Min. pad spacing: 0.20 mm (any color)
Keep at least 0.09 mm clearance between soldermask openings and neighboring traces.
Soldermask Expansion 1:1 LDI equipment upgraded in June 2025. Pad size:soldermask opening can be 1:1
Solder mask ink thickness ≥ 10μm
For 1-layer and 2-layer boards utilizing standard process routes, or for specialized DFM requirements, designers can specify "Do not modify original solder mask size" during ordering.

topics.reading: The 0.10 mm minimum is the pad-to-pad bridge for green (0.13 mm for black/white), so the mask colour must stay green for the recorded via web. The 0.10 mm trace margin is above the 0.09 mm opening-to-trace minimum.
topics.factory_question: Whether the custom openings and local dams are kept as drawn (for the 2-layer leaf, the "Do not modify original solder mask size" option; for the 4-layer controller, 1:1 LDI), and whether a 0.10 mm web between a tented via and an opening is held (the published 0.10 mm row is pad spacing, not a tented-via rule).

topics.design: vias tented by retained mask; controller minimum drill 0.2 mm

stated.quote: Tented Vias Definition: This option is the most commonly used. Vias are covered with soldermask, and surface finish such as HASL is not applied to vias.
Vias holes should ideally be 0.4 mm or less and no larger than 0.5 mm if permitted by routing and current-carrying requirements. Larger vias are not guaranteed to be fully covered
the solder-resist can flow down the via hole, leaving a thinner layer on the annular ring than in other parts of the board.
Single-sided or double-sided vias, holes in pad, and vias with a distance less than 0.35mm from the pad cannot be plugged with ink.
Filled vias should have ≥ 0.35 mm clearance from other soldermask openings (e.g. pads)

topics.reading: Tented is the matching via-covering choice. Ink plugging is not: our 0.10 mm via web is below its 0.35 mm clearance.
topics.factory_question: Whether tenting holds over the 0.10 mm web to the nearest opening on 0.8 mm boards; thin mask on the annular ring is a stated normal appearance.
